comment.body:
Thanks for continuing to update this. The current thread confirms PowerToys exits unexpectedly, but it still does not identify whether this is a crash, an external termination, or a module-triggered shutdown path.

Please provide the next evidence that can identify the failing path:

1. Reproduce the unexpected exit and comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the diagnostic ZIP captures the same session.
2. If Windows logged an Application Error for the same time, please copy the Event Viewer details, especially the faulting application/module and exception code.
3. Please include a short timeline of what was happening right before the exit, which PowerToys modules were enabled/in use, and whether PowerToys restarted automatically.
